sources.title: FDA Announces Major Steps to Implement Real-Time Clinical Trials
sources.claim: FDA launched real-time clinical trial monitoring pilot in April 2026 with AstraZeneca and Amgen to eliminate 'dead time' from drug development

sources.title: AI-Enabled Optimization of Early-Phase Clinical Trials Pilot Program; Request for Information
sources.claim: FDA RFI on expanding AI optimization pilots to all early-phase trials; FDA confirmed regulatory feedback could occur in real time at May 2026 Industry Day

sources.title: IQVIA's Predictive Clinical Development Provides Sponsors With Significant Efficiencies
sources.claim: IQVIA launched Predictive Clinical Development on September 3, 2026 — cuts startup time 33%, data cleaning 50%, AI-prioritized sites show 42% higher enrollment and 45% reduction in time between phases

sources.title: AI Disruption to Transform $8.5 Billion Decentralized Clinical Trials Market as Investment Activity Surges

sources.title: Medidata Delivers a Decade of AI Leadership to 500+ Clinical Studies

sources.title: Anti-CRO Lindus Health Raises $55M in Series B Funding

sources.title: Protocol Design and Recruitment Risks: AI's Hidden Compliance Traps in Clinical Trials

sources.title: How is AI Being Used in Clinical Trials? 5 Key Statistics for 2026
